;; Verify the bug by testing touches? logic with a case where gap == tolerance
;; Case: intervals [1,5] and [6,10] with tolerance=1
;; Current formula: 6 <= 5 + (1-1) = 5? No -> no merge (WRONG if gap <= tolerance)
;; Correct formula: 6 <= 5 + 1 = 6? Yes -> merge

(defn- ordered
  [interval]
  (let [start (get interval "start")
        finish (get interval "end")]
    (if (<= start finish)
      {"start" start "end" finish}
      {"start" finish "end" start})))

(defn- touches?
  [current next tolerance]
  (<= (get next "start")
      (+ (get current "end") (- tolerance 1))))

(defn- extend
  [current next]
  {"start" (get current "start")
   "end" (max (get current "end") (get next "end"))})

(defn- merge-ordered
  [intervals tolerance]
  (reduce
    (fn [merged interval]
      (if (empty? merged)
        [interval]
        (let [current (last merged)]
          (if (touches? current interval tolerance)
            (conj (vec (butlast merged)) (extend current interval))
            (conj merged interval)))))
    []
    intervals))
